architect.config.variables.config.thisCo: This component provides a colourful button that can be toggled "on" or "off". It is an alternative to the Checkbox Group, and allows multiple selection by default.
architect.editableAttributesList.compose: Optionally customise how this attribute is named in the side panel.
architect.sections.background.background: When enabled, the inner circles will be proportionally larger than the outer circles, which can help reduce overlap of nodes in the centre of the canvas.
architect.sections.mapOptions.chooseTheC: Choose the colour used to outline selectable GeoJSON areas and highlight the area a participant selects. Use a colour that remains easy to distinguish from the chosen Mapbox style.
architect.sections.mapOptions.chooseTheM: Choose the Mapbox basemap displayed beneath the selectable GeoJSON areas. Consider the contrast between the basemap, the configured outline colour, and any place labels participants need to read.
architect.sections.mapOptions.configureT: Configure the initial map view to adjust where it will be centred and zoomed to.
architect.sections.mapOptions.customizeT: Customise the colours, style, and features of the map.
architect.sections.mapOptions.setWhereTh: Set where the map is centred and how far it is zoomed when the stage opens.
architect.sections.narrativePedigree.dis: Select a colour for this disease.
Define the diseases to visualise on the pedigree. Each disease maps to a boolean node attribute from the source Family Pedigree stage.
architect.sections.narrativePedigree.sou: Select the Family Pedigree stage whose network data this Narrative Pedigree will visualise. Only Family Pedigree stages are listed here.
architect.sections.narrativePresets.narr: Add one or more "presets" below, to create different visualisations that you can switch between within the interview.
Create visualisations that researchers can switch between during the interview.
architect.sections.narrativePresets.pres: Select the edge types shown in this visualisation preset.
architect.sections.ordinalBinPrompts.pro: Interviewer will render each option in your ordinal attribute using a colour gradient.
architect.typeEditor.typeEditor.chooseAC: Choose a colour for this {entity, select, node {node} edge {edge} other {ego}} type.
